title: Form 1: DS&AI Program of Examinations
description: This form is used to create a report that shows your current study program. Its purpose is to be shared with the examination committee, so that they can check whether it satisfies the requirements of DS&AI programs and approve it or inform you of how it does not satisfy the requirements. This form has built-in validation that should help you create a valid study program.
completedHtml: Thank you for completing the form
completedBeforeHtml: You have already completed this form.

validators.text: Enter a valid enrollment month from 2010 to 2035.

elements.title: Mandatory courses
elements.description: The mandatory courses of the DS&AI program consist of 5 core courses and a mandatory choice of one out of three core electives. (All these courses are 5 EC.)

elements.description: Every DS&AI student should have these courses in their program.

elements.name: specialization_panel
elements.title: Specialization electives
elements.description: As part of your program, you must choose at least six specialization electives. (All these courses are 5 EC.) These are grouped per trajectory. You must have two major trajectories from which you choose at least two courses and also choose two courses from one or more further trajectories (minors).

choices.text: 2IMP40 Empirical Methods in Software Engineering (5 ECTS)
2AMS30 Network Statistics for Data Science (5 ECTS)
2AMM40 Advanced Topics in Artificial Intelligence (5 ECTS)
2AMS40 Optimal Decision Making & Reinforcement Learning (5 ECTS)

elements.name: selected_major_trajectories
elements.title: Which two qualifying trajectories do you want to use as your majors?
elements.description: More than two trajectories meet the {rule_major_min_credits} ECTS threshold. Select two as majors; the others count toward the minor.

elements.name: project
elements.visibleIf: {core_elective} <> '2amv10' and {db} notcontains '2amd20' and {aiml} notcontains '2amc15' and {pmva} notcontains '2ami30' and {pmva} notcontains '2amv10'
elements.html:
You must choose at least one project course!

Your study program must include at least one project course. Below, we show the possible project courses. Select one of them above as a core elective or specialization elective.

  • 2AMV10 Visual Analytics
  • 2AMI30 Process Intelligence in Action
  • 2AMC15 Reinforcement Learning in Practice
  • 2AMD20 Knowledge Engineering

pages.name: free_elective_space
pages.title: Free-elective space
pages.description: The free-elective space is 15 ECTS. It can be filled with free electives, homologation courses or an internship.

elements.name: free_electives_panel
elements.title: Free elective courses
elements.description: Add master-level courses that are not already counted elsewhere in your study program. These may be offered by your own program, another TU/e department or another university. Courses must not substantially overlap with each other or with other courses in your program.

elements.name: free_electives
elements.title: Free elective courses
elements.confirmDeleteText: Are you sure you want to delete this free elective?

elements.name: homologation_panel
elements.title: Homologation courses
elements.description: Homologation courses are bachelor courses used to make up deficiencies in previous knowledge. Please check your admission letter to see assigned homologation courses. It is also possible to pick a maximum of three bachelor courses yourself to compensate deficiencies, if you think it is necessary.

elements.name: unassigned_homologation
elements.title: Are any homologation courses self-chosen rather than assigned in the admission letter?

elements.name: unassigned_motivation
elements.title: Motivation self-chosen homologation courses
elements.description: Explain the deficiency addressed by each self-chosen bachelor course and for which master-level courses they are required.

elements.name: internship_panel
elements.title: Internship
elements.description: An internship is optional and contributes 15 ECTS to the free-elective total. For an external internship, the graduation project must be executed internally. For an internal internship, you cannot graduate with the same supervisor.

elements.name: seminar
elements.title: What seminar is included in your study program?
elements.description: Choose the seminar that corresponds to your intended graduation cluster. Seminars are 5 ECTS courses.
